propositions: test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml both hand-copy the same gate+suite command set (lint, pip-audit, test matrix), creating a drift-prone duplication policed only by test_ci_workflow_parity.py

A new reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml must factor the shared gate set into one workflow_call source with three jobs (lint, pip-audit, test matrix), parameterized by gerrit-refspec/gerrit-project/gerrit-url like _optionality.yml, taking no secrets
Both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must delegate to the single reusable workflow instead of inlining gates, eliminating drift by construction

Five independent test_ci_workflow_parity.py safety invariants (gate existence, script asymmetry, optionality contract, pre-commit SKIP, linter deduplication) must be preserved by retargeting them from the old dual-source to scan the new reusable workflow

The refactored gerrit-verify.yaml build-and-test job must remain a single named job (needs: [clear-vote, require-ticket]) that splits lint/config-check out of the 4x matrix to run once, while vote still requires build-and-test
